Resolves #20285

A `Neo.button.Base` whose `url` arrives after construction now renders the `target` its `urlTarget` names. `updateTag()` already owns the tag-owned attributes of the button's polymorphic root (`href`, the tag, native `disabled`), and it now reconciles `target` too: a `url` link takes `urlTarget`, while a route link and the `button` tag carry none. `afterSetUrlTarget` delegates to `updateTag()`, so config order no longer decides the rendered attribute. This removes the trigger behind neomjs/neo-agent-institution#840, where the Observatory's "Open on GitHub" navigated its own window.

Evidence: L2 (unit: the button's vnode on the engine's Node setup) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-3). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs` › "a url that arrives after construction opens per urlTarget, and a route link stays in this window": a late `url` renders `_blank`, and a cleared `url` renders none |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same test, where a route link renders no `target` and `urlTarget: '_self'` renders `_self` |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the same spec file. Its late-url assertion is red on `dev` (`## Test Evidence`) |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. Out of scope, noted in a defect-note (review 5774944502): an anchor-tagged button still carries the button's `type="button"`. That predates this change, and `updateTag()` never reconciled `type`.

## Test Evidence

- Base/head: with `src/button/Base.mjs` at `dev`, the new arm fails at "the urlTarget default reaches a url set after construction" (expected `"_blank"`, received `undefined`). At head, all 9 button tests pass.
- Mutation: keying `target` on any link instead of a `url` turns "a route link carries no target" red.
